capabilities: Add notes and highlights to Markdown selections, headings and code lines
Select text in PDFs and ebooks with the keyboard
Attach notes to PDF pages and regions from the command palette
Review annotations per document or across documents in a library
Export annotations as one-way Markdown snapshots
extras: Manual install from release files; annotations and reading state are kept in a scholiast/ folder in the vault, with no account or network use. The README mentions a full bilingual guide that is not included in the text.
motivation: The README says it exists so you can capture a thought where you are, without switching windows or touching the original file.
problem: Annotating while reading in Obsidian normally means leaving the document or editing the source file, so thoughts get lost or originals get altered.
summary: Keyboard-first annotation tool that adds highlights, notes and tags to Markdown, PDF and ebooks without changing the original files.
